name: John B. Walker
role: Host of the Pyramid Park hotel in 1885
bio: John B. Walker took over as host of Medora's Pyramid Park hotel in March 1885, after buying an outfit for it at Mandan, and the paper praised the standard he kept. In November 1885 the sheriff seized his goods for unpaid labor bills, and their sale raised enough to pay them; a Pittsburgh paper that December reported a marriage license issued to a John B. Walker of Irwin station, Pennsylvania.
